messages: incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered — HIGH error rate on inference-gateway-usw2 (auto-pager)
incident-bot: Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC123456 — Summary: 5xx spike (gateway) > 8% error rate over 5m, SLO threshold breached :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC123456 auto-assigned to @alex (oncall). Priority: P1. Escalation in 5m if unacknowledged.
alex: acked — looking now. can someone post the quick metric snapshot?
maria: grabbing graphs. error rate ~9.8% on inference-gateway-usw2 for the last 5m, 90th latency stable. Traffic steady at ~4k rps.

samir: logs show a surge of backend 502 from model-pool-a: 
```
03:14:22 GET /v1/generate 502 "upstream reset" model-pool-a/127.0.0.12
03:14:23 GET /v1/generate 502 "kv cache miss and backend busy"
```
jin: rolling deploy to model-pool-a started ~10m ago? any coincident canary?
maria: there was an infra canary for kernel update on pool-a at 03:05, but it finished successfully. we see evictions and OOMs on a small subset of nodes around 03:12.
evan: checking node pool autoscaler and GPU driver logs now. if nodes flapped we'd see reconnects. running: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-pool-a`

alex: mitigation plan: 1) scale down model-pool-a to reduce pressure 2) shift traffic to model-pool-b (fallback routing) 3) warm cached prefixes on pool-b 4) monitor errors — who can run the routing step?
samir: i'll kick traffic slice to pool-b. running traffic-reroute command: `./ops/reroute --from pool-a --to pool-b --pct 60` — doing gradual 60% now.
maria: warming prefixes on pool-b with synthetic replay (prompt set 'warm-v1'). starting now.
pagerduty-bot: @alex acknowledged INC123456 — responders: alex, maria, samir. Escalation paused.
jin: after 2 minutes of reroute, errors dropped to 4.1% on pool-a and overall error is 3.3%. good sign. continuing ramp to 90% to verify stability.
evan: found kernel oops on 3 nodes in pool-a -> driver crashes causing sidecar resets. logs: `nvdriver: retried 3 times, fatal` — isolating nodes from scheduler.
alex: ok isolate effected nodes (cordon + drain) and keep pool-a reduced. samir keep traffic shift until pool-a repaired. set PD note: 'isolating nodes with nvdriver oops'.
samir: increased reroute to 90%. running: `./ops/reroute --from pool-a --to pool-b --pct 90 --grace 30s` :white_check_mark:

maria: monitoring customer impact — top five customers by requests show <5% of requests affected due to routing; error pages count peaked at 2.1k/min but falling. updating status page draft: 'partial degradation, mitigation in progress'.
alex: good. start RCA collection: get dmesg from affected nodes, driver versions, kernel packages. jin please take lead on infra RCA, maria on customer impact + status wording.
jin: ack, collecting artifacts. uploading to /incidents/INC123456/artifacts (links will be posted).
evan: note — we saw a surge of memory cgroup pressure at 03:11 preceding the oops. suspect interaction between kernel build and a recent model-allocator change. adding to RCA hypothesis.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC123456 status updated: mitigation in progress — error rate decreasing. Next update in 15m or on major milestone.

alex: preparing handoff — i'm going offline in 20m. if errors rebound >5% escalate to SRE rotation and PD escalation targets. handoff doc: key actions completed: traffic shifted (90% to pool-b), affected nodes cordoned, warming cache on pool-b, artifacts collected.
samir: I can take first oncall handoff. @alex leave a quick checklist in the doc and i'll keep watch for 30m. also will run `kubectl uncordon` only after driver patch verification.

maria: status page updated and posted: https://status.example/incident/INC123456 — message: 'Partial degradation affecting ~3-5% of requests; mitigation routed most traffic to fallback pool. Engineers investigating root cause.' :pencil2:

alex: thanks team. leaving notes: PD incident link, artifacts path, 'do not restore traffic to pool-a until driver fix applied and nodes pass healthcheck (gpu driver >= 510.12)'. handing off to samir. :hand:
samir: taking over. monitoring alerts + dashboards. filing follow-up postmortem template now. will update once driver patch validated or pool-a steady for 30m.
incident-bot: Reminder: Please update the incident channel with a final postmortem link once available. :memo:
pagerduty-bot: INC123456 set to 'under control' by samir — remaining tasks: RCA, driver patch rollout, postmortem. Escalation timers cleared.
